title: Audit finding
description: One record per exception, deviation, nonconformity, observation or recommendation raised by any assurance activity. The auditor's words are preserved verbatim in severity_as_stated and description; our interpretation lives only in control_id, mapping_confidence and disposition. Never re-grade someone else's finding and present it as theirs.

locator.description: Where in the document. Page, section, control reference. An unlocatable finding cannot be defended in the next audit.

framework_ref.description: Identifiers only — CC6.1, A.8.5. No framework text. ADR-0003.

kind.description: Use the word the source document used. A SOC 2 exception is not an ISO nonconformity and flattening them loses the thing that determines urgency.

severity_as_stated.description: VERBATIM from the source. Null if the source stated none. Do not infer one and do not translate another scale into ours.

control_id.description: Our mapping. Null is a legitimate and important answer — it means the finding has no home in the inventory, which is itself the gap.

mapped_by.description: A named human. Mapping is a judgement and carries a name.

accepted_by.description: Required when disposition is risk-accepted. Acceptance carries a name, never a team.
